title: Is your skincare actually working?
text: Skincare products make big promises. But when lighting, routines, and your skin change every day, it's hard to know what's working. Receipts turns that question into a small, honest experiment for one person.

title: An agent designs the trial
text: Start with a product and the claim on its label. The Protocol Agent chooses a matching skin concern, estimates the YouCam API cost, and designs either a before-and-after study or a split-face trial with a randomly assigned control side.

title: Lock the protocol before measuring
text: Review the protocol and lock it before day one. The primary metric, schedule, and smallest change of interest are recorded with a hash. The agent's tool calls are visible, so the design can be inspected.

title: Capture checks before analysis
text: In the local app, browser-side checks look at framing, brightness, pose, and consistency before upload. This public preview uses a generated sample and mock analysis: no personal photo is sent, and no YouCam units are spent.

title: An honest first verdict
text: One check-in is nowhere near enough to judge a skincare claim. The Verdict Agent reads the locked analysis and says not enough data, instead of inventing a result. Its reasoning and tool use are available on the trial page.

title: A synthetic 21-day example
text: Here is a clearly labeled synthetic 21-day split-face example. The chart shows treated and control measurements, the estimated difference, and an approximate confidence interval. Daily looks are exploratory; a final classification waits for the planned endpoint.

title: A shareable receipt
text: Each receipt brings the product, claim, protocol, chart, and verdict together, and exports as an image without a selfie. Split-face mask intensity is an experimental proxy, not a validated medical or clinical outcome.

title: Powered by YouCam AI Skin Analysis
text: Under the hood, the real integration uploads a checked photo to YouCam, submits an asynchronous skin-analysis task, polls for results, and tracks the unit cost. A consented live analysis verified this flow; this demonstration uses mock data. Receipts: better questions, with uncertainty included.
